title: Staff Misconduct – Verbal Abuse, Threats, and Harassment by LATAM Employee André BD Marinho at Guarulhos Airport (GRU) – Including Breach of LATAM Code of Conduct
category: Staff Misconduct / Consumer Abuse / Criminal Conduct / Corporate Code of Conduct Violation

incident.location: Guarulhos International Airport (GRU), Sao Paulo, Brazil — LATAM Airlines counter, Terminal 2
incident.flight: LA8159 segment GRU-GYN (04 Apr 2024, originally ticketed as SCL-GRU-GYN multi-city). Precursor incident — preceded Santiago false accusation/forcible removal (05 Jul 2024) by 3 months.

incident_timestamp_display: 4 de abril de 2024, 02:05 AM BRT – Aeroporto Internacional de Guarulhos (GRU), São Paulo, Brasil
allegation_summary: On 4 April 2024, after a missed connection at Guarulhos Airport, LATAM counter staff member André BD Marinho engaged in sustained, unprovoked verbal abuse and threats against passenger Leandro Disconzi. When asked for his name, Marinho replied with dismissive challenges ('pode me procurar nas redes sociais'), then escalated to extreme profanity, including 'vai tomar no cu, velho' and self-identified while cursing: 'André BD Marinho está mandando esse imbecil tomar no cu'. Marinho further issued veiled threats ('Você acha que tem um louco pra cima de mim?') and continued the abuse after knowing he was being recorded. This incident occurred in the context of LATAM’s broader failure to provide assistance after denying boarding (preterição). The conduct constitutes criminal injúria (Art. 140 CP), ameaça (Art. 147 CP), and multiple violations of the Consumer Defense Code, including strict liability (Art. 14), exposure to ridicule (Art. 42), and abuse of consumer weakness (Art. 39 IV). The employer LATAM is vicariously liable under Civil Code Art. 932, III. No lifetime flight ban was imposed at GRU; the violation is limited to the staff misconduct on that date.
